  • About
    About
    Goren-Kidon tailors state-of-the-art solutions in defense and security. Since 2008, we have provided our customers with the best service, equipment and connections worldwide.
    We proudly represent the leading companies, supply technologies and equipment at affordable prices, along with the training and implementation by qualified technicians and instructors. Our professionals accompany the client from the initial stages of fitting, adjusting, and modifying, to the purchasing and finally the installation and implementation of the equipment. We choose our partners very carefully! We choose companions for the journey, for a path that we pave together.
    Read More
    Quality
    At Goren-Kidon Group, our commitment to quality is unwavering. We hold our products to the highest standards and take every step necessary to ensure that they meet our rigorous quality control requirements. Our team consists of talented professionals who have extensive experience in the management industry. We are dedicated to helping our clients achieve their goals and are always looking for ways to improve our services. If you are looking for a reliable and high-quality management service, look no further than Goren-Kidon Group.

  • The Group
    At Goren-Kidon Group, we provide a comprehensive design to manufacturing service to help you bring your ideas to life. Our team is made up of four divisions that work together to provide a full solution, from concept to delivery. Whether you need help with design, prototyping, production or engineering, we can provide you with the support you need to make your product a reality. With years of experience and top-of-the-line technology, our team is here to help you achieve success.

    A studio that focuses on creating innovative products that are both functional and aesthetically pleasing. We believe in the importance of pushing the boundaries of creativity and design.

Tailoring Solutions Since 2008

Get to Know Us

Born in defense, Goren-Kidon has evolved into a sophisticated group, providing improved off-the-shelf products redesigned to meet our customers' needs at our state-of-the-art labs located in the Ness-Ziona Science Park, very close to the prestigious Weizmann Institute of Science.
Today, our four divisions provide customers with a complete solution, from planning and industrial design to engineering, manufacturing, and after-sale support, including technical teams for in-field assistance.
We are able to fully design new products, engineer all mechanical and electronic parts and components for your project, as well as build supporting software with the most advanced UX/UI at your fingertips.
Our highly experienced team of professionals is dedicated to the success of each project. We take great pride in our commitment to quality and innovation, and strive to bring you the very best products and services. Let us help you bring your ideas to life!/UI at your fingertips.
